verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's Checkout API documents embedding payments in the merchant's own website or app without redirecting to an external page. It also documents secure card-data capture with a simplified PCI path and one API for web and mobile. The evidence describes a flexible API rather than prebuilt, customizable embeddable UI components, so the 'customizable components' part of the story is only implied. Payment-button styling applies to the hosted Checkout Pro, not to embedded checkout. Missing for 10: documented embeddable UI components with customization options (styling/theming), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Incorporate a flexible API into your website so that customers can shop on your website or app without being redirected to an external page.
Receive card transaction data securely and with minimal hassle, enabling a simplified path to PCI certification.
Integrate into web or mobile apps using the same API.
